description: A painted cow in the dining room has a spot on its side that resembles a classic Hidden Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: Cow illustration in the dining room
whereToLook.exactSpot: The cow's side. Look at the spots for one shaped like three circles.

bestTip: Ask for a table with a view of the cow if you are going on purpose.

viewing.notes: Table service; a reservation gets you inside.
